hypothesis: W-R17 mixed curriculum learned pair-block swaps but did not resolve one isolated adjacent interchange. Train on a variety of single local swaps and hold out both unseen swap positions and unseen cohorts. Compare 16-width pooled mismatch versus max and top-two local difference features.
freeze: All train positions, heldout positions, training examples, noise amplitudes, transformations, features, thresholds and budgets frozen before first use. No recycling W-R17 heldout or threshold tuning after result.
population: Reuse exact W-R16B 16x4 raw-synthetic generator, observed candidate global +17 dev/+79 heldout, genuine bounded per-tick 4-channel jitter multiplier11.
representation_arms: 16 identical mean anchor-relative local first-channel circular-difference features
16 identical max of consecutive transition mismatch features
16 identical mean of top two consecutive transition mismatch values
learning: Six models (two frozen curricula times three equally wide features), 16 weights+bias each, 1728 development pairs per arm, 32 passes at LR=.1, no training on test cohorts, same timestamps/capacity/labels.
analysis: Report per-heldout-family×noise×model accuracy and per-seed confusion. LOCAL_SINGLE_SWAP_TRANSFER iff at least one single-adjacent-curriculum representation achieves >=.80 accuracy in ALL six heldout cells and exceeds its coarse baseline by >=.15 on aggregate; PARTIAL iff any single curriculum representation increases aggregate by >=.05; NEGATIVE otherwise.
controls: All negatives only reorder 15 tail positions, first observation preserved, candidate multiset same within paired positive/negative
No hidden extra model width or training examples
Immutable parent, first-use artifact, one final full regression
No oracle, label or future information to models
claim_limit: Synthetic supervised temporal pair study; not general language learning.
